group_assessment.weighting: Academic clinical-genomics centre reporting consecutive paediatric epilepsy diagnostics; no WWOX-focused publication, but the cohort carries four WWOX-diagnosed individuals and one cDNA-level splice result.

field_density.note: No PubMed record pairs WWOX with the phrase 'deep intronic'; this cohort reports a homozygous deep intronic WWOX variant with a cDNA consequence.

multihop.note: 50 references enumerated; none is WWOX-direct. The WWOX content is this cohort's own diagnostic data (main text plus Supplementary Table S9), not a citation, so no hop is owed.

entries.proposition: A homozygous WWOX c.107+119C>G deep intronic variant was shown by cDNA analysis to cause inclusion of the first intron in NM_016373, producing a premature stop codon.
entries.snippet: A homozygous WWOX c.107 + 119C>G variant was shown to lead to the inclusion of the first intron in transcript NM_016373 , leading to a premature stop codon after cDNA analysis.
entries.anchor: Results, Diagnostic variants (deep intronic variants paragraph)

entries.proposition: WWOX accounts for four of the fifty-one solved individuals with infantile epileptic spasms syndrome in this cohort, behind STXBP1 (6) and level with CDKL5 (4).
